name: axHub users
author: Brett
description: The hub's users inside the console (admins): every hub account with its role, permissions, password state and sign-in, add, edit, disable and remove accounts, through the console's hub-pages relay with a hub session. Module axHub (the hub's own pages inside the console, folded from apps/axhub-web Nov 20 2026). Only a wall admin's browser may use it; uninstalling it removes only these pages.
